name: Attai
overview: Attai is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified uniquely as the son of Jarha. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or significant narrative details provided beyond his lineage. As a member of Judah, he is part of the foundational tribal heritage of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Attai means 'timely' or may be an abbreviation of Athaiah. This proper name is not indicated to have been given directly by God, but it carries a meaning that may reflect a characteristic or circumstance at the time of naming.
familyAndRelationships: Attai is explicitly identified as the son of Jarha and the father of Nathan, establishing a clear paternal lineage. These relationships are recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:35-36, providing a genealogical link within the tribe of Judah.
scriptureSignificance: Although Attai's role in the biblical narrative is limited, his inclusion in the genealogical record of Judah highlights the importance of preserving the lineage of God's chosen people. His mention underscores the faithfulness of God in maintaining the family lines through which the Messiah would eventually come, emphasizing the continuity of God's redemptive plan through generations.
